hero.title: The ABC of Marriage
hero.subtitle: An alphabetical guide to activating bliss in your marriage.
paragraphs: A bestselling book on marriage, written by two people who have been in one for twenty-five years — and who work with other people’s for a living.

It is organised alphabetically rather than as an argument, which means you can open it at whatever you happen to need this week and put it down again. Marriages are not repaired in one sitting, and the book does not pretend otherwise.
hero.note: Retail links are being finalised — email in the meantime and copies will be arranged directly.

uses.title: Four ways it gets read
uses.intro: An alphabetical guide is a reference, not a course. That is deliberate — it survives being picked up and put down, which is the only reading pattern a busy marriage actually supports.

items.title: For couples
items.body: Read a letter at a time, together. The alphabetical structure means you can start anywhere and finish nothing — which is exactly how most couples actually read.

items.title: For marriage preparation
items.body: Used alongside the Before You Marry programme as a shared reference, so both of you are working from the same language.

items.title: For churches and groups
items.body: The structure lends itself to small-group study — one entry per session. Bulk pricing is available on request.

items.title: As a gift
items.body: Frequently bought for weddings, anniversaries and engagements. Ask about signed copies when you order.
